info.tactics: The Gatekeeper is an unusual artillery unit that compensates for its poor range by warping the very definition of Range with its gates, which allow the Gatekeeper and its allies to extend their reach and attack from otherwise impossible angles. However, the Gatekeeper builds Heat the more its gates are used, and its enemies are perfectly capable of exploiting gates themselves.
info.terse: Unusual artillery that uses portals to attack from impossible angles.

actions.name: Unlock Doors
actions.detail:
Open two Line 3 gates in free spaces within Sensors but not necessarily line of sight. Each gate has a black side and a red side, clearly indicated to all characters on the field, and counts as a normal piece of Height 1 hard cover.
Whenever a character uses an ability that can target another character within line of sight and X spaces, if a gate is within their targeting range, they can target any character within line of sight and X spaces of any other gate, as long as they and the target character are on the same color sides of their respective gates. For attacks, cover is determined from the gate within X spaces of the target. Reactions can also be triggered using the same rules. After each action or reaction that relies on a pair of gates, any Gatekeepers that opened either of the gates take 1 Heat.
If there are more than two gates per Gatekeeper on the field, the oldest excess gates close immediately. You may close any number of gates as a protocol or before taking this action again.

name: Skeleton Key
effect: This weapon gains +1 Accuracy against targets that do not have cover.

actions.name: Evert
actions.detail: Choose any number of gates within Sensors and flip their orientations (i.e. the black side becomes red and vice versa).

actions.name: Summon
actions.detail: Teleport a character within Range 3 of a gate to a space within Range 3 of any other gate. The starting and ending spaces of the teleport must be on the same color sides of their respective gates. Hostile characters may avoid this effect by passing an Engineering save. You may use this action on yourself.

actions.name: Watchman
actions.trigger: A character begins movement within Range 3 of any gate.
actions.detail: You may attack the triggering character with Overwatch as long as they are a valid target for one of your weapons, dealing half damage, Burn, and Heat.

actions.name: Slam Shut
actions.detail: Choose a gate within Sensors (but not necessarily line of sight) that was not opened this turn. You may use the Skeleton Key to attack a character within line of sight and Range 5 of that gate, then immediately close it.

actions.name: Close Sesame
actions.trigger: A character makes a ranged or melee attack using a pair of gates.
actions.detail: You suspend part of the attack in space and time. The triggering attack deals half damage, Burn, and Heat, and you gain the Open Sesame quick action until the end of your next turn. If the attacker is hostile, they may negate these effects by passing a Systems save.

actions.name: Open Sesame
actions.detail: Release the suspended attack. The original attacker must repeat the attack roll against a target of your choice within Range or Threat of any gate, dealing half damage, Burn, and Heat. Line of sight and cover are determined as if the gate were the origin of the attack. Take 3 Heat.

name: Almighty Janitor [Veteran]
effect: 1/round, when the Gatekeeper is in the Danger Zone and uses the Skeleton Key to Skirmish, its attack becomes Line 8.

active_effects.name: Almighty Janitor
active_effects.condition: You Skirmish with the Skeleton Key while in the Danger Zone.
